translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content.text: Nikech Sayun ok analingʼ,
bende nikech Jerusalem ok anasik kalingʼ,
nyaka timne makare rieny ka yawruok mar piny,
kendo warruokne obed marieny ka mach makakni.
Ogendini none timni makare,
kendo ruodhi duto none duongʼ mari;
bangʼe noluongi gi nying manyien,
ma Jehova Nyasaye biro chaki.
Inibed kondo maber e lwet Jehova Nyasaye
bende inibed osimb loch e lwet Nyasachi.
Ok ginichak giluongi ni Kama Ojwangʼ
kata chako pinyi ni kama Odongʼ Gunda.
To noluongi ni Hefziba kendo pinyi noluongi ni Beula;
nimar Jehova Nyasaye nobed kodi gi mor
kendo pinyi nochal gi dhako mokendi.
Kaka wuowi kendo nyako e kaka yawuoti nokendi;
to bende kaka ngʼama okendo mor gi chiege,
e kaka Nyasachi nobed mamor kodi.
Yaye Jerusalem, aseoro jorit e ohinga mari
ok ginilingʼ odiechiengʼ gotieno.
Un muluongo nying Jehova Nyasaye kik unyosru,
kendo kik umiye yweyo nyaka chop olos Jerusalem
mi omi obed dala marahuma mipako e piny ngima.
Jehova Nyasaye osesingore gi lwete ma korachwich
kendo gi bade maratego ni,
“Ok nachak ayie
wasiku kaw chambu micham,
jopinje mamoko bende ok nochak omadh divai manyien,
ma usetiyone matek;
to jogo mano kagi ema nochamgi,
ka gipako Jehova Nyasaye,
bende jogo ma choko olemb mzabibu ema nomadhgi
e laru mar kara maler mar lemo.”
Kaluru, kaluru dhorangach!
Losuru yo ne joga.
Buguru, buguru yore!
Goluru kite.
Tingʼuru bandera malo mondo pinje one.
Jehova Nyasaye oselando wachne e tung pinje duto niya:
“Wachne nyar Sayun ni, ‘Ne, Jaresni biro!
Ne, michne ni e lwete
kendo jogo mosegonyo wuotho kode.’ ”
Enoluong-gi ni Oganda Maler,
ma Jehova Nyasaye Osewalo;
kendo noluongi ni Dala Midwaro Gwedho
ma en Dala Maduongʼ Ma Ok Nochak Ojwangʼ.
